author: IGN
description:
Join developer Reissad Studio for a deep dive into what you can expect from The Dead & Damned update for Bodycam, the first tactical multiplayer FPS game with a true body-camera view in Unreal Engine 5. The Dead & Damned update for Bodycam features the return of the Zombies mode, a new map, new systems, and improvements to the experience. Learn how zombies move, how to survive through exploration, and how to progress. 

Additionally, version 0.9 brings the advances from the Lock & Loaded update, including the new weapon handling, new animations and reloads, and the stress system. Changes also include changes to weapon boxes, where they can now come with random attachments like sights and suppressors. A new rarer box will also be added: the loadout box. The ragdoll stumbling system applies to the infected in version 0.9. The video also gives you a closer look at the maps, your objectives, and much more. 

The Bodycam version 0.9 update, The Dead and Damned, launches on November 13, 202
title: Bodycam Zombie - Official 'The Dead and Damned' Behind the Scenes Look

author: IGN
description:
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake is finally here on the Nintendo Switch 2! We’ve gone hands-on to bring you the ultimate side-by-side graphics comparison, putting the 1998 N64 classic up against the modern-day Nintendo Switch 2 remake!

How does the Nintendo 64 version stack up against the Switch 2's upgraded visuals, improved lighting, and upgraded framerates? We’ve combed through a bunch of iconic Hyrule locations to show you exactly what has changed in this massive comparison.

From your first steps in Kokiri Forest to exploring the depths of Ocarina’s temples and dungeons, we've got a lot to show you!

Alongside the fully overhauled character models, environmental textures, enemies, and the epic final Ganondorf boss fight. This is everything you need to know about the OoT Remake compared to the 1998 original!

#IGN #Zelda #OcarinaOfTimeGraphicsComparison
title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake VS N64 Original Comparison (Bosses, Dungeons, & More!)

description:
In The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake on the Nintendo Switch 2, rupees serve as the game’s main form of currency, and all players intending to traverse the land of Hyrule will need them in order to obtain new armor parts, recovery items, magic beans, and weapon ammo over the course of their adventures. In this guide, we’ll demonstrate a few tips and tricks on how to obtain rupees easily and quickly so that you can spend less time farming and more time exploring!
